title: suderra.edge-activation-receipt.v1
description: Signed by the edge-provisioning key after the device's first authenticated MQTT CONNECT commits the activation (ADR-048 DEC-5.7, DEC-5.8). The agent checks it against the bundle's edge-provisioning anchor and stores it as $DATA/state/activation-receipt.dsse; root copies and verifies it, then records ACTIVE. An agent-written marker is never registration evidence.

manifest_digest.description: Statement digest of the suderra.edge-provisioning.v1 manifest root installed.

expires_at.description: Last instant at which root may accept the receipt. Once accepted, root records ACTIVE in the lifecycle store and never re-derives it from this window (statements.json reverification).
